plugins.name: devskillslearning-pipeline
plugins.description: Complete AI-first Java/Spring Boot SDLC automation — 19 skills: scaffold, write-code, code-review, write-tests, refactor, diagnose, secure, deploy, document, migrate, github, monitor, design-api, database, resilience, perf-test, release, dependency, api-integrate. Covers REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, reactive, Spring Modulith, event-driven, batch, multi-tenancy. Full enterprise stack: OAuth2/JWT, K8s, CI/CD, Problem Details (RFC 7807), WireMock, test slices, read replicas. GitHub integration: create epics/stories/tickets, PR review by URL or ticket ID, issue management via MCP.
